topic: How Living Things Depend on Their Environment
key_concepts: Environment includes living and non-living things
Living things are alive and have basic needs
All living things depend on the environment for food, water, and shelter
Ecosystems include abiotic factors and organisms adapted to their conditions
Humans depend on plants and the environment for food, air, water, clothing, and shelter
Humans modify the environment in positive and negative ways
Animals are adapted to the conditions of their habitats
Animals can be carnivorous, herbivorous, or omnivorous
Plants use sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water to make sugar for food
Plants get nutrients and minerals from the soil
Plants release oxygen and provide food for people and animals
